## The paper

> Gordin, S., Kapon Epshtain, D., & Fire, M. (2025). Shaping History at Scale:
> Computational Diplomatics and the Diachronic Evolution of Cuneiform Tablet Morphology.
> *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences*.

**BibTeX:**

```bibtex
@article{gordinShapingHistory2025,
  title     = {Shaping History at Scale: Computational Diplomatics and the
               Diachronic Evolution of Cuneiform Tablet Morphology},
  author    = {Gordin, Shai and Kapon Epshtain, Danielle and Fire, Michael},
  journal   = {Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences},
  year      = {2025},
  note      = {In review}
}
```
